title: 5 signs your phone runs your nights
format: Dark painting cover + one line per paper slide
why: The Scream as the cover for a self-diagnosis list: viewers count how many they tick.
caption: i got 5/5. what did you get? #screentime #phoneaddiction

caps.text: 5 SIGNS YOUR PHONE RUNS YOUR NIGHTS..

slides.text: You plan to sleep at 11 and **check the time at 1:40**.
You open an app, close it, and **open it again** without thinking.
You **cannot fall asleep** without something playing.
Your phone is **the first thing you touch** every morning.
You **feel robbed** of the night, so you stay up to take it back.
